headline: هل يستطيع الذكاء الاصطناعي بناء مساعد خدمة عملاء موثوق؟ دليل من 53 مهمة بناء
reviewer: AI editorial review (not a human reader test)
summary: اختبرت الدراسة مساعدين برمجية بنت أنظمة خدمة عملاء في 53 مهمة محاكاة؛ بلغ أفضل متوسط آلي 23.9 من 100، فلا يكفي أن تعمل الشيفرة كي تُنشر.

source_evidence.claim: 53 construction tasks: 6 airline, 6 retail, 6 telecom, 35 banking
source_evidence.assessment: 6+6+6+35=53; simulated construction tasks, not production deployments

source_evidence.claim: Best automated overall mean 23.9/100; expert-authored reference 82.2/100
source_evidence.assessment: Means across 53 task scores; not raw counts of successful projects

source_evidence.claim: One banking evaluation succeeded in 1/93 cases and failed in 92/93
2,868 distinct artifacts and more than 5.5 million text tokens
source_evidence.assessment: Text-token total excludes additional images, PDFs and recordings
Clearly labelled hypothetical and not attributed to the benchmark

decision: BLOCKED pending actual mobile viewport/browser verification and workflow confirmation
terminology_evidence: Coding agent, customer-service agent, API, held-out case, ground truth, reference ceiling and mean score are explained at first use or in the glossary.
language_evidence: Arabic draft passed a 20–30 second comprehension check; English labels are parenthesized and the secondary study is isolated in a labelled side box.
